format: zip of a PSP save folder for a PSone Classic (PARAM.SFO, ICON0.PNG, CONFIG.BIN, SCEVMC0.VMP and SCEVMC1.VMP): each .VMP is '\0PMV' 128-byte header + 131072-byte card, slot 1 and slot 2; the card holds 4 save(s), 4 for this game (BASCUS-94491drgn0000, BASCUS-94491drgn0001, BASCUS-94491drgn0002, BASCUS-94491drgn0003)

note: Filed under GameFAQs' 'PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)' section, but it is not a PS3 export (.psv): zip of a PSP save folder for a PSone Classic (PARAM.SFO, ICON0.PNG, CONFIG.BIN, SCEVMC0.VMP and SCEVMC1.VMP): each .VMP is '\0PMV' 128-byte header + 131072-byte card, slot 1 and slot 2. Only SCEVMC0.VMP (memory card slot 1) is converted and loaded; SCEVMC1.VMP is slot 2 and holds no saves. one-saves (1saves convert) does not read this file: this archive holds 2 cards: SCUS94491/SCEVMC0.VMP, SCUS94491/SCEVMC1.VMP
